visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A group of six people stands in a brightly lit studio with a 'DRINK DRUNK' pink logo in the background. A woman in a grey hoodie and another in a white vest are at the center. Confetti graphics burst on screen as they clap excitedly while looking at the camera. (2) Three women engage in a conversation in a medium close-up shot; the central one in a beige blazer speaks with animated facial expressions and hand gestures. Digital overlays with variety-show captions like '花惹發?' appear prominently at the bottom. (3) The screen splits vertically: on the left, the woman in the blazer continues her story with exaggerated expressions; on the right, her friends react with intense laughter and pointing. Progress bar graphics and variety text frequently update across the frame. (4) The woman in the beige blazer acts out a word during a guessing game, moving her arms and head dynamically to communicate. The background displays rotating 'AI COME PLAY' logos and digital blue grid patterns on a dark floor. (5) A final split-screen displays the woman's face on the left while on the right, the group continues to laugh hysterically. One person holds a tablet showing text for the game as they all cheer together.

Short 'whoosh' transition SFX and buzzer-like comedy sounds are heard every few seconds during edits.
